label: Bible Study
prompt: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own _____.
verse: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
note: Said in his hometown of Nazareth — the crowd soon tried to throw him off a cliff.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine _____.
verse: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
note: God guides with His eye — and the next verse says don't be like the mule that needs a bit and bridle.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the _____ of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
verse: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
note: Even after his death, Elisha's bones brought a man back to life — a miracle-worker to the very end.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will _____ all men unto me.
verse: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
note: John adds that 'lifted up' signified what death he should die — the cross as a magnet for all men.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his _____.
verse: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
note: Forgive the repentant brother, says Paul, so Satan gains no advantage: 'we are not ignorant of his devices.'
